units.source_text: 大竹七段曾被誉为本因坊丈和名人再世。

en.t: Otake, seventh dan, was once praised as the reincarnation of the Meijin Honinbo Jowa.

units.source_text: 丈和是古往今来首屈一指的力棋，秀哉名人也经常被人誉为具有丈和的棋风。

en.t: Jowa was one of the foremost power players of all time, and Meijin Shusai was also often said to possess Jowa's style of play.

units.source_text: 棋下得稳重，力战为主，凭实力克敌。

en.t: His play was steady and dignified, centered on fighting strength, and he defeated opponents by sheer ability.

units.source_text: 这是一种豪放而强烈的棋风。

en.t: It was a bold and forceful style of go.

units.source_text: 他善于挽救危机和适应变化，每每创造出精湛的棋局，在业余棋手中间更有声望。

en.t: He was skilled at rescuing crises and adapting to changes, repeatedly creating masterful games, and he enjoyed even greater prestige among amateur players.

units.source_text: 他们这么想：这两人均全力相拼，连连激战，纵观全局，你争我夺，可能会呈现出一派丰富多彩的棋势。

en.t: They thought this: if these two men both fought with all their strength, clashing again and again, then across the whole board their back-and-forth struggle might produce a rich and varied position.

units.source_text: 可是这种期望完全落空了。

en.t: But that expectation was completely disappointed.
